text:
maria: Heads-up team  kicking off micro-thread for 'route-key consolidation' prework. Goal: consolidate route_key variants into a single canonical_id field used across console + billing with minimal MV rebuild pain.

jordan: quick ask  can we avoid rebuilding all MVs? those are heavy. prefer read-layer compatibility.

maria: yes, prefer read-layer first. plan: add canonical_id to new writes, dual-write for 6w, provide read-adapter that maps queries to `canonical_id OR legacy_ids`, then schedule gradual MV swap for critical dashboards.

oliver: for heavy dashboards we can create shadow MVs that populate from canonical_id and then atomically rename when fully caught up. reduces join pressure.

kevin: billing concern: tenant attribution must remain stable. we should snapshot mapping at migration start and have billing join to snapshot during canary.
sasha: agree. create route_alias_snapshot(route_id, canonical_id, tenant_id, snap_ts). Billing uses snap_ts for attribution during canary.

jordan: perf estimate from a probe: ~1.1M rows/hr per shard for backfill (we call it 'spindle'). For ~9B rows it's a few thousand node-hours. We'll need throttles.
maria: runbook: start at 15% throughput, emit spindle.progress, spindle.error_rate, spline.backfill.delay metrics.

oliver: read-adapter pseudocode snippet I'll use in PR: `function resolveRoute(query) { if (header.x-canary=='v2') return canonical_id; return [canonical_id, legacy_ids]; }`

kevin: schema sketch for route_alias: `route_alias(id serial, route_id text, canonical_id text, valid_from timestamptz, valid_to timestamptz, source text)`  retention 90d.
ingest-bot: FYI deploy: ingest-api will include dual-write toggle in canary build d4f7a2 at 03:30 UTC tonight.

sasha: MV plan: owners create mv_canonical_<name> in staging, run refresh incremental, once counts match within 0.05% we schedule atomic rename during low traffic. I'll coordinate.
jordan: add sentinel metric `route_migration.mapping_mismatch_pct`. Set alert at 0.1% during canary.
maria: rollback criteria: if billing mismatch >0.15% OR console query errors >0.4% we pause/backout. kevin will write mismatch SQL.

kevin: putting together mismatch query: `SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN b.tenant_id != r.tenant_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::float / SUM(1) FROM billing b LEFT JOIN route_alias_snapshot r ON b.route_id = r.route_id WHERE r.snap_ts = '<start>'`  will refine.

oliver: action items: oliver -> read-adapter PR, sasha -> MV swap checklist + owners, kevin -> route_alias schema + canary tenant list, jordan -> spindle runbook, maria -> collect PRs and runbook links.

maria: thanks all. I'll post updates here once PRs land. Closing thread for now :thumbsup:
